data.description: The Minicopter, or mini, is a two-seat helicopter for flying around the map. A mini costs 750 scrap from the [Airwolf Vendor](/world/airwolf-vendor) and comes with 100 low grade fuel. It burns 30 low grade a minute, so a full 500 tank gives about 16.7 minutes of flight. It holds up to 5 [flares](/items/flare), and shredding one gives back 200 scrap. Park it inside, since outside it decays much faster.
